message.content:
{"diagnosis": "Trace shows 256-word NOP sled expecting progress with no trap, but reports TRAP: cpu trap asserted and tohost FAIL 0xdead. Legal NOP has instr_trap==0 yet incorrectly enters the trap/PCPI path in cpu_state_ld_rs1. Root cause in excerpt is inverted polarity at line 1584: case (1'b0) matches 0==0 for legal insns instead of case (1'b1) for trap==1.", "patch_diff": "diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -1583,3 +1583,3 @@
 				(* parallel_case *)
-				case (1'b0)
+				case (1'b1)
 					(CATCH_ILLINSN || WITH_PCPI) && instr_trap: begin
", "expected": "tohost PASS, no TRAP: cpu trap asserted, fetch progress through NOP mem completes"}
